# sfcompute_users (Data Source)

Reads users from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/users`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Filter to the user with this email address. Matched case-insensitively against the member's non-deleted identities.
- `ending_before` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the previous page.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by user ID or resource path (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number)
- `starting_after` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next page.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String)
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `email` (String) The member's primary email, or `null` if they have no recorded email identity.
- `first_name` (String) The member's first name, or `null` if not recorded.
- `id` (String)
- `last_name` (String) The member's last name, or `null` if not recorded.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a user resource. Format: sfc:user:<name>.
